status: draft from owner direction: every store's list is sectioned one consistent, Wolt-like way ("Frequently ordered", "Desserts"...), named in each store type's own words; the engine later learns and contributes to it
purpose: Section vocabularies for storefront menus, one scheme per Discovery category. A section ID is `<scheme>:<section>` and never changes once published. Studio may later rename titles, add sections and retire them.
precedence: catalogue: the merchant's own section on the item (`section`) wins
engine: a section ID the engine assigned (`sectionId`) comes next
rules: otherwise the item's name is matched against the keywords below
matching: Names and keywords are lower-cased and accents removed. A keyword matches whole words; a trailing * matches any ending. Sections with a priority are tried first, lowest number first; then the rest in display order; then the shared sections; anything left goes to the fallback. Sections show in display order, items keep catalogue order.

naming.note: What a store calls its list, its items and its demand section. The most specific match wins: subcategory, then category, then the kind (from the subcategory's journey), then the default.

signals.note: Sections filled only from real history, shown above the named sections and repeating their items there, as Wolt does. Until an item carries the signal, the section does not show. Never estimated or seeded.
